universe_selection: Four liquid long-existing contracts present in public CCXT Binance market fixture, selected without strategy outcomes. SOL excluded because this fixture lacks its futures contract. Current-survivor sampling; no historical membership claim.
warmup: At least 10 days preceding each scored interval, historical inputs only; reserve entire final block from feature/plan generation until code/config/decisions freeze.
purge_embargo: 24h unscored gap between blocks exceeds greatest 8h holding horizon plus 5min pending-order lifetime. Plans whose expiry plus maximum hold exceeds block end are excluded. All pairs split at same UTC clocks. No fitted labels or classifiers.
prior_tuning: PR11-14 Gate windows repeatedly inspected, including August and May-July hourly momentum. Binance January-April 15m data have no matching source in repository; independence from owner's other unseen work cannot be established. Gate dollars are never compared as venue-equivalent Binance dollars.
source: Official data.binance.vision monthly UM klines 15m/1h/5m, markPriceKlines 1h, fundingRate; ZIP SHA256 verified against source CHECKSUM. UTC millisecond timestamps verified by range and cadence, never guessed from spot convention.
metadata_constraint: Binance exchangeInfo returned HTTP451. Use explicitly unqualified public CCXT Binance test-fixture snapshot for a separate offline Binance native scenario, with its own ticks/lots/minimums and maker/taker assumptions. Snapshot is not authenticated historical exchangeInfo. No remote API bypass; all results PARTIAL_COST_MODEL / INSUFFICIENT_ECONOMIC_VALIDATION, even if profitable. Do not present scenario as venue-grade economic proof.

cost_model.fee_basis: CCXT Binance fixture generic taker for both sides, conservative for maker; historical account tier UNKNOWN
cost_model.funding: actual archive event clocks; preceding hourly mark OPEN, exact settlement mark UNKNOWN

H1_PARENT_TARGET.rule: Preserve V4 candidates, shortlist, entry, stop and holding/fast exits. From preknown previous UTC day and previous completed 8h session opposing highs/lows only, select nearest distinct level whose reward is between 2 and 3 original price-risk units and whose net RR under the unchanged 38bp admission allowance is >=1.25. Otherwise retain original3R target. Local15m swing remains a caution, never an automatic veto. Target must remain within original6ATR horizon. No threshold sweep.
H1_PARENT_TARGET.mechanism: A preknown parent/session objective may be more attainable than generic3R without sacrificing net-payoff admission. Audit authority separates first barrier from objective.
H1_PARENT_TARGET.falsification: No actual changed targets/fills, lower full-original-candidate expectancy than V4, negative validation or extra10bp sensitivity, dependence on largest winner, or finer-detail reversal. A logical ledger consistency repair does not establish economic improvement.

entry_research: Frozen immediate and0.15ATR passive policies only. Prior body/RVOL switch remains failed Gate evidence; no new switch without distinct causal development evidence. Expiry/5m/trade-through are execution sensitivities, not alpha hypotheses.
primary_metric: Native constrained net USDT / all raw strict V4 candidate IDs in same partition. Also selected-original-plan denominator; missed fill cash zero, never classify nonfill as a losing trade. Cross-variant extra PnL is not matched-candidate alpha.

decision_rules.REJECTED: Fails preregistered comparison or no improvement
decision_rules.UNQUALIFIED: Any unresolved historical venue metadata/fee/funding or authentic execution qualification
decision_rules.PROMISING_RESEARCH_ONLY: Positive development/validation/holdout and stress, lower CI>0, no largest-winner dependence, >=30 held-out fills; still cannot override metadata limitation
decision_rules.INSUFFICIENT: Too few fills, CI includes zero, incomplete input, or invalid independent evaluation

holdout: Open once for all frozen comparisons after development/validation and source/code/config freeze. Always open frozen controls for honest limited inference even if H1 fails; failed H1 may be retained as preregistered negative control, no promotion or revision. Validation feedback never changes thresholds. No second chance.
